product_metadata.title: Floit, Exclusive Black Metal Frames, Shiny Brushed Thin Aluminum for Home Wall decoration, perfect size of A3 11.7 x 16.5 inches photos pictures paper documents (Black)
features: Elegant design and Color - Thin, Matt Black with brushed texture will express exclusive and timeless beauty. Don't compare with cheap wood frames. Aluminum Frames will make your photos or documents stand out much more luxurious.
Perfectly designed to display A3(297*420mm) documents or pictures. You can also purchase perfect size of art prints for this frames from us, floit_shop.
Easy to open and change pictures vertically or horizontally on Wall by Unscrewing the hook and repositioning it.

No risk of breaking the glass. We use thick Crystal-Clear Acrylic though it is more expensive than glass or thin plexiglass cover.
✔️Thin acrylic windows bend over time. You don't have to worry about bending because we use windows twice as thick as other brands' products, which are very thick and strong.

✔️Please remember this. The front window is covered with a transparent protective film. It may look like a scratch, but this is a scratch on the film, so if you peel the film off, you can see that the window is a clean window without any problems. Protective packaging for the window by a film. Just take it off before use.
